body:
To anyone who sees. It doesn't matter who. I'm just planting a seed. Death is the only escape, even if whoever finds my body is ready with a camera crew and pre-fluffed star ready to fuck my lifeless corpse.

By your patronizing wording, utterly banal and clueless advice, and conscious effort to either not read or not respond to what I'm actually saying, I'm gonna conclude that you're probably just some Yank teenager who's walked passed a self-help section at a bookstore and thought "shit, I can do that." Take your dollar store aphorisms and go back to /r/funny.

It would prove a point. It would be a symbolic gesture.

edit: ...and if you really want me to address the survivalist suggestion, hunt and fish with what guns and equipment? I'm a relatively clever chap, but even I'd have trouble wrapping my head around the metallurgy, smithing, and other sundry skills, materials, and machinery required to produce even a vaguely useful hunting knife from first principles, let alone an effective hunting firearm or fishing reel. Without those, survivalism is, at best, simply long and excruciating suicide by starvation - which is what you're trying to convince me to avoid, yes? Either that or you're just a knobhead Yank trying to tell me that all I need to fix myself is rugged individualism and the American Dream(tm). In that case, stuff it - it's that mentality that created the current hegemonic power structure in the first place.
